Container.Name: Trackarr
Container.Overview: Trackarr is a self-hosted companion app for Radarr and Sonarr that gives you a unified view of your media automation. Monitor downloads, queue health, missing media, and what needs your attention — all in one place.[br][br]Features include queue monitoring with health scoring, missing media tracking, multi-server support, background routines, and download history.[br][br][b]Setup:[/b] After starting the container, open the WebUI and add your Radarr/Sonarr servers under the Servers page. You will need the host, port, and API key for each instance.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Trackarr web interface.

Config.Name: Config Path
Config.Description: Path to store Trackarr configuration and database.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID Trackarr runs as; files in /config are owned by it. 99 = nobody on Unraid.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID Trackarr runs as. 100 = users on Unraid.

Config.Name: Time Zone
Config.Description: Time zone for times shown in the UI, e.g. America/New_York. Use the same value as your other containers.

Config.Name: ASPNETCORE_URLS
Config.Description: Internal listen URL. Do not change.

Config.Name: Database Connection
Config.Description: SQLite database path. Only change if you know what you are doing.
